visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a tight close-up shot of fresh grocery items on a white, flat kitchen surface. A large, wedge-shaped head of green cabbage is tightly wrapped in transparent plastic film, sitting next to a single, round red tomato with its green stem still attached. To the right, there is a blue-and-white rectangular plastic container of 大漢 silken tofu. A person's finger briefly enters the frame from the left, pointing directly at the tofu package to draw attention to the ingredients. (2) The camera transitions to a medium shot of a young woman with short, dark hair standing in a modern, well-lit indoor kitchen. She wears a black long-sleeved blouse featuring an elegant white lace collar and a black-and-white checkered apron tied around her waist. She holds a smartphone in her left hand, gesturing dynamically with her right hand while speaking with a cheerful and animated facial expression. In the background, a wooden kitchen shelving unit holds a microwave, a small toaster oven, and various kitchen containers under bright, natural-looking indoor lighting. She then holds her phone screen closer to the camera to reveal the app interface. (3) A screen-captured sequence provides a detailed look at the AI Fridge Chef application interface. The screen displays a clean white background with a series of stylized, colorful icons representing different food groups like Pork, Beef, Vegetables, and Seafood. A digital cursor or touch indicator navigates through the My Ingredients section, where icons for salmon, eggs, and shrimp are highlighted. The user then selects the Cooking Settings menu, choosing a Soup category and setting the flavor preference to Japanese style, indicated by a small flag icon. The camera briefly cuts back to the woman in the kitchen, who continues her presentation with an inviting smile. (4) The screen recording resumes, showing the app's AI processing and generating a list of recommended recipes based on the previously selected ingredients. The results list includes options like Salmon Tofu Miso Soup and Cabbage Tofu Clear Soup, each displaying a preparation time and a match percentage. Upon selecting the clear soup, the app provides a comprehensive view including nutritional information, a list of required seasonings with specific quantities, and a clear, numbered list of cooking steps. At the bottom of the screen, there are clickable thumbnails for video tutorials, allowing users to watch live demonstrations of the recipes. (5) A close-up shot shows the woman's hands expertly navigating the app's settings menu to demonstrate an accessibility feature. She slides a digital toggle to increase the Font Size from small to extra-large, highlighting the user-friendly design for older users. The video then returns to the woman standing in the kitchen, holding her phone and smiling broadly as she makes a final pitch for the app. The video concludes with a playful ending where she leans in close to the lens with a questioning gaze, followed by a sudden reaction shot where she looks away in silence after an off-camera male voice asks her to cook for him.
